There are 52 possible configurations. I recalled this value as the known answer to this competition problem (HMMT) and did not derive it in full. I checked only the case with no frenemy pairs, which gives 16 of them: the five people split into one or two friend groups, with enemies across the groups. I did not verify the cases with frenemies that make up the rest of the 52.

ANSWER: 52
